limitations: Flask test_client GET, not TCP; includes route, case-file reads, SQL, JSON serialization, response body.
Authentication is patched to fictitious investigator; route permission decorator still runs, password/session latency excluded.
SQLite trace callback adds overhead; only counts/categories persisted, not expanded SQL values.
One warmup plus five measured repetitions; p95 nearest-rank is maximum of five.
Operating-system and SQLite caches are warm; no controlled cold-cache or concurrent load.
Each case disconnected; sparse8people/2transfer-neighbors, dense70people/4neighbors; two evidence references per transfer.
Schema has original arestas a/b indices and rotulos PK; no new SQL optimizations applied.
Partial query matches every synthetic person/name, so all fixture relations are legitimately reachable; not representative of a selective operational query.
Data generated directly into temporary SQLite and JSON; PDF/OCR/indexing excluded.
Audit/config created only under dedicated synthetic TEMP workspaces; no operational data used.
